info.title: PuzzleLeadScoring API
info.description: Check companies against Puzzle's ICP, score them, and exchange lists with other tools. Every /v1 call needs the header `x-api-key`. AI only runs when asked, within a cost limit.

get.description: Is the API up (no key needed).

post.description:
One company, answered while you wait: ICP YES/NO/PENDING with the reason, lead score, tier, reasoning and
every data point. Cached, so asking again is instant. Use this from a Clay HTTP API column.

Up to 25 companies at once, answered while you wait: their free steps run at the same time. Same answers as
POST /v1/check for each (AI questions stay open; use a list with ai=true for those).

get.description: Every list with its state and counts (ICP YES / NO / PENDING, Strong fit).

post.description:
Start a whole list in the background: phase 1, optional AI, phase 2, optional AI, final list, optional Clay
push and callback. Follow it with GET /v1/lists/{name}.
Same as POST /v1/lists, with a CSV file upload.

get.description: Progress: state, current step, AI usage, ICP YES / NO / PENDING counts, push and callback result.
Every row of the list: your original columns plus ICP, score, tier, reasoning and every data point.

One company in a list: its result row, every answer with its proof (quote, page, source: code, directory
or AI) and what the free directories found.

post.description: Re-apply the rules to saved pages, e.g. after changing scoring.json. Free: no downloading, no AI.
Send the list's rows to a Clay table webhook, one row per request.

get.description: What the AI step would cost for this list, in both modes. Nothing is sent.

post.description:
Run the AI step on an existing list in the background (after phase 1: phase=icp; after phase 2:
phase=signals). Refused if the estimate could exceed ai_options.max_cost_usd. Follow it with GET /v1/lists/{name}.

Prospeo company data, the last layer of the waterfall, for companies whose data points the earlier layers left
open. Refused above max_credits.

Decision-makers at the list's ICP companies from Prospeo (founders, C-suite, finance lead), with emails if asked.
Refused above max_credits.

get.description: Contacts found for the list: one row per person, with the company's ICP, score and tier.

post.description: Accuracy against the right answers: ICP, tier and any data point, plus every disagreement with our proof.

get.description: The actual AI cost per company (phase 1, phase 2, answers, web searches, reused answers).
The run log: every phase, AI and evaluate run with counts, AI cost and time.

The free directories for one company: YC (by domain), SEC EDGAR and the IRS non-profit list (by legal name).
Free; no AI.
Companies checked and AI cost per list for a month (default this month), and the monthly budget left.
Every data point: its column name in the results, group (must-have, exclusion, fit, buying, weak) and points.
Tables in the signed-in Clay workspace.

post.description: Read a Clay table and process it as a new list.

phase.title: Phase
phase.description: icp: settle PENDING verdicts; signals: AI-only signals and score

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: accurate: one AI call per data point (default). cheap: grouped calls, about 3 times cheaper

search_signals.title: Search Signals
search_signals.description: Phase 2: ask the buying signals only web search can answer (about $0.10 per ICP company in accurate mode)

max_cost_usd.title: Max Cost Usd
max_cost_usd.description: Refuse the AI step if the estimate could exceed this. Default: API_AI_MAX_COST_USD in .env, else 5

companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Up to 25 companies, each like the body of POST /v1/check

wait_seconds.title: Wait Seconds
wait_seconds.description: How long to wait before answering 'still running'

employees.title: Employees
employees.description: Employee count, used for the size segment

signals.title: Signals
signals.description: Also run phase 2 (signals and lead score) if the company is ICP

ai.title: Ai
ai.description: Also run the AI step (costs money; capped by ai_options.max_cost_usd)

refresh.title: Refresh
refresh.description: Download the website again instead of using the cache

wait_seconds.title: Wait Seconds
wait_seconds.description: Answer within this time; longer checks keep running, ask again

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Right answers: Domain, Expected ICP (YES/NO), Expected tier (Strong fit/Weak fit), 'Expected: <data point>' (Yes/No). Leave out to use Expected columns in the list itself

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: Rows with at least a Domain (or Website) column; other columns are kept

ai.title: Ai
ai.description: Run the AI step after each phase (costs money; capped)

push_to_clay.title: Push To Clay
push_to_clay.description: When done, push every row to a Clay table webhook

clay_webhook_url.title: Clay Webhook Url
clay_webhook_url.description: Clay webhook; default is CLAY_WEBHOOK_URL from settings

callback_url.title: Callback Url
callback_url.description: When done, POST the list's status and summary to this URL

emails.title: Emails
emails.description: Also reveal verified emails (1 credit each)

per_company.title: Per Company
per_company.description: Contacts kept per company: founder/CEO first, then the finance lead

max_credits.title: Max Credits
max_credits.description: Refuse if this could use more Prospeo credits

phase.title: Phase
phase.description: icp: open must-haves and exclusions; signals: open fit and buying signals

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Only the first N companies (0 = all that need it)

max_credits.title: Max Credits
max_credits.description: Refuse if this could use more Prospeo credits (1 per matched company)

table_id.title: Table Id
table_id.description: Clay table id, e.g. t_abc123 (see GET /v1/clay/tables)

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Only the first N rows (0 = all)

only_icp.title: Only Icp
only_icp.description: Push only rows where ICP = YES
